I'll group the orders by category and write the per-category totals as a CSV artifact. (No plotting library is available in this environment, so this produces a table, not a chart.)

```python
import pandas as pd
from agent import files
df = pd.read_csv('/input/orders.csv')
summary = df.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().reset_index()
files.artifact('summary.csv', summary.to_csv(index=False))
print('WROTE:', len(summary), 'rows')
```
